dialect.detail: IBM CICS online program using EXEC CICS LINK/SEND/RECEIVE/XCTL/RETURN; part of the CardDemo sample application (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, CDEMO- prefixed fields, COUSR02 mapset). Likely compiled with IBM Enterprise COBOL.

purpose.domain_detail: CardDemo application – user administration / security management screen for updating user records
purpose.summary: COUSR02S is a CICS online screen program that allows an administrator to look up and update user account information (first name, last name, password, user type) via an RPC-style CICS LINK call to a backend program (COUSR02L). It handles screen navigation, field validation, and error messaging within the CardDemo mainframe demo application.

notable_features: EXEC CICS LINK to backend RPC program (COUSR02L)
EXEC CICS SEND/RECEIVE MAP with BMS mapset COUSR02
EXEC CICS XCTL for screen navigation
DFHCOMMAREA with OCCURS DEPENDING ON EIBCALEN
Multiple COPY statements: COCOM01Y, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CSUSR01Y, COUSR02, DFHAID, DFHBMSCA
88-level condition names for operation codes and return codes
No EXEC SQL – pure CICS, no DB2 direct access
verdict.notes: Part of the IBM CardDemo open-source mainframe training/demo application. Fixed format confirmed by max line length of 72 and no lines over 72. The inline data definitions after COPY COCOM01Y suggest the copybook provides a parent group and these are subordinate entries appended in-stream, which is a common pattern in this application suite.
